title: Air Fryer Salmon Croquettes
description: These salmon croquettes made with canned salmon, panko, and lemon are perfectly seasoned and cooked in an air fryer for an easy, fuss-free meal.
ingredients: 1 (14.5 ounce) can salmon, drained and flaked
1 teaspoon seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Combine salmon, panko, onions, mayonnaise, beaten egg, lemon juice, dill, seafood seasoning, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Mix to combine and shape into 6 equal-sized croquettes.
Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line the air fryer basket with parchment paper and spray with avocado oil.
Working in batches if needed, place salmon croquettes into the prepared basket and spray the tops with avocado oil.
Cook in the preheated air fryer until croquettes are golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes. Flip croquettes over, spray again with avocado oil, and cook for 4 to 7 more minutes.
